title: Landing Gear Bay — Brake Control and Wheel Sensing Harnesses

ata.title: Centre Fuselage Wiring — Landing Gear Bay Wiring

abstract: Wiring diagram of the left and right main gear bays, showing the brake and steering control unit interfaces, the wheel speed and wear sensing runs and the harness break points at the gear leg.

sections.purpose: This sheet shows the wiring in the main gear bays for the brake and steering control units, the wheel speed and wear sensing runs and the pressure transducer interfaces at each brake position.
sections.sheet_note: Sheet 1 shows the left bay and sheet 2 the right bay; the two are mirror images and share item numbering. The control unit connector keying is shown at the bay equipment position: shell size 25, key position B at the upper connector and key position D at the lower. The harness break at the gear leg is shown explicitly, because a gear change disconnects and reconnects it and a high resistance introduced there produces the cross channel comparison fault rather than an obvious open circuit. The pressure transducer runs are drawn separately from the wheel speed runs even where they share a support.
sections.routing_note: The control unit harness runs from the bay equipment position in zone 734 along the gear bay roof to the break point at the gear leg, then down the leg to the axle. The wheel speed and wear sensing runs follow the same path on separate supports and terminate at each brake position. The centre gear bay run to zone 771 branches at the roof and does not pass the leg break point.

The wheel speed and wear sensing runs follow the same path on separate supports and terminate at each brake position. The centre gear bay run to zone 771 branches at the roof and does not pass the leg break point.
